text: The covered mirror and the quiet service panel confirm the same lesson: C1 is a remembered entrance, not a road home. The attendant still points toward the reception lounge and the stair hall.

views.text: The covered mirror and shabby service panel remain in the dim coatroom. The goat-faced attendant points toward the lounge and stairs; the mirror offers no road home.
